$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

versioned.description: Each write bumps a monotonic `version`; prior versions are retrievable via `GET …/files/{path}?version=N`. Latest-version retrieval is the MUST regardless; history is best-effort up to `maxVersions`.

maxFileBytes.description: Per-file byte ceiling; writes beyond it return `workspace_too_large`.

maxVersions.description: When `versioned: true`, the number of historical versions a host advertises it will retain (history best-effort beyond the mandatory latest).
